steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each team is placed by its utilisation against the planned band.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Utilisation at 97 percent
findings.fix: Add cover or move work to a team with headroom

findings.title: Hours recorded with no planned capacity
findings.fix: Add the planned capacity or stop the hours

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] team-field.csv:12  Utilisation at 97 percent.
       Fix: Add cover or move work to a team with headroom.
[medium] team-audit.csv:19  Hours recorded with no planned capacity.
       Fix: Add the planned capacity or stop the hours.
[low] team-planning.csv:26  Utilisation under 60 percent.
       Fix: Review the team's plan.
Not checked: Quality of the hours recorded.
pros: Checks a utilisation above 95 percent or below 60 percent, and a team with recorded hours and no planned capacity.
cons: Not checked: Quality of the hours recorded.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-capacity-utilisation skill on the records for this review.
